title: VRAM test node
summary: Allocates on its device exactly what its memory model says, for spec 002's AC8 (npm run bench:fit). It lives outside nodes/, so the app never lists it.

overrun.doc: On attempt 1 only, allocate this share more working memory than the model says, so the allocation passes the cap.

fallbacks.doc: Allocate the working memory through ctx.fallbacks, whose second way allocates what the model says.

weights.source: allocated by the node itself, exact by construction
